verification.name: End-to-end request returns model response and metrics correlate with device trace.
verification.detail: OpenAI Python 2.16.0 called the local Responses gateway for a deterministic simple request and a function-tool-format request. The simple request ran over USB and emitted token 25 (decoded ':'); the tool request ran over verified Wi-Fi ADB and emitted token 364 (decoded '.\n\n'). Both Responses objects were accepted by the SDK as incomplete(max_output_tokens) one-token results, and both independently matched device trace SHA, emitted token, input-token count, inference/completion counters and zero failure delta. Device traces show 24 layers, bounded peak RSS and actual flash/cache metrics.

verification.name: Gateway and client protocol checks.
verification.detail: Full repository pytest passed 40 tests, py_compile passed, and the OpenAI SDK full-stack mock passed both scenarios with checkpoint/resume behavior.

limitations: A03 uses a one-token max_output_tokens=1 cutoff so the official Harmony parser is never asked to fabricate a complete message from a partial stream; the response status is explicitly incomplete(max_output_tokens).
The tool-format scenario was completed over Wi-Fi ADB after the USB ADB server reset; the simple scenario provides the USB round-trip proof, and both transports are recorded in the benchmark.

The stock service currently runs a full 24-layer prefill for each request, so device latency is measured in tens of minutes for these prompts; no client timeout, retry or cached laptop inference was used.
Android logcat contains unrelated historical process-kill lines, but the final OOM/LMKD scan had no matching inference failure and the service metrics reported zero failures.
notes: The A03 gateway was restarted after code changes and after the ADB transport recovery; the final service was also cleanly restarted before the evidence run.
The gateway retains at most 32 trace documents keyed by SHA-256; trace records contain the raw decoder response including flash, cache, timing and RSS fields.
Wi-Fi ADB was verified with model shell, harmless push/hash test and a managed tcp:18080 forward before the tool scenario.
